text:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a short throughput sweep on staging for continuous-batching tuning? Want qps + tail latency for these combos: max_batch=8/16/32, max_tokens=256/512, queue_ms=0/10/50. Target model rdlm-4b-quant-v2 on p4d-2x. Need numbers for a canary tomorrow.

ben: I can take 8/16 runs. pinging @kai for 32. any specific prompt mix?

kai: I can do 32. use the 'short-ish' promptset from /perf/prompt-sets/conv_short.json. I'll run steady-state (~10k tokens) and collect flame graphs + batch hist.

ben: running now with warmup: `./perf/run_sweep.sh --model rdlm-4b-quant-v2 --batches 8,16 --max_tokens 256,512 --queue_ms 0,10,50 --duration 600 --warmup 120`

perf-bot: Scheduled job perf-1759934576 started on staging-pool-3. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/1759934576

kai: quick note — include `--steady_warmup=120s` otherwise KV-cache warming skews first 2 mins. also capture kv cache hit rate and batch-size histogram.

maria: yes include warmup + KV metrics. also capture per-token latency and percent-batched requests.

ben: uploaded raw results gist: https://internal-gists/abc123 — summary: qps (queue_ms=10): batch8->1200, batch16->2100, batch32->3000. For max_tokens=512 p99 for batch32 jumped to ~420ms.

kai: noted. 32 + queue_ms=50 reduced p99 by ~30ms vs queue=10 but raised mean token compute by ~8% due to larger effective batches. Looks like sweet spot might be batch=16, max_tokens=512, queue_ms=10 for our latency/cost tradeoff.

maria: can you both open a short PR to adjust defaults and expose a rollout flag? Tag me for review. Also run a quick regression against ephem-model-3b to confirm no quality regressions with these buffer settings.

ben: on it. PR coming. I'll add perf dashboard panels comparing current default vs candidate, and attach the artifact set.

kai: starting ephem-model-3b regression runs now (same sweep parameters).

perf-bot: perf-1759934576 finished. Artifacts: /artifacts/perf-1759934576.tar.gz

ben: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4827 — includes new defaults (batch=16, queue_ms=10, max_tokens=512) and a rollout flag `cb.batch_default`. Left a TODO for extended stress testing and a short note about cost delta.

maria: thanks both. if canary looks good we'll flip the default in Dedicated tomorrow morning. Also add a note to the release notes about the p99 behavior and recommended knob settings. :thumbsup:

ben: will do, tagging docs and SRE for the change.

kai: added the flame graphs and batch histograms to the PR. 

maria: great work — appreciate the quick turnaround.
